work.title: Designing trust, intelligence and scale across an enterprise software portfolio
work.pageLede: Five case studies of UX leadership across Platform, Agentic AI, Generative AI, Data and Security.
work.intro: Over four years I moved from leading product design for IT operations management to leading user experience for a multi-product mainframe portfolio. These case studies show how the UX team I lead turned customer evidence into AI-ready experiences across the GenAI, Platform, Data and Security product lines, and how I led the people, decisions and cross-functional alignment behind them. Product names are anonymised.

autonomy.title: Autonomy is a dial, not a switch.
autonomy.body: In the agentic AI work, we let customers graduate trust over time: Ask, Assist and Agent modes with friction proportional to risk. Turn the dial to see how the same incident plays out.

leadership.title: Four things I bring to every team
leadership.body: I help organizations elevate design from a delivery function to a strategic driver of product, platform and business transformation.

thinking.title: AI and the future of UX
thinking.pageTitle: AI and the future of UX
thinking.pageLede: Ten articles on design, leadership and decisions: observations and opinions on how AI is reshaping the discipline. The series moves from a point of view, to practice, to leadership, and ends with the idea that ties it together. Each article stands alone.

journey.title: From visual craft to enterprise UX leadership
journey.pageLede: From design execution to enterprise UX leadership — a path driven by curiosity, continuous learning and a passion for meaningful experiences.

photography.title: The art of noticing
photography.body: Photography is my lifelong practice of observation. These frames come from early mornings at the wetlands, where patience and low light reveal brief moments of character.
photography.pageTitle: The art of noticing: wetland birds in low light
photography.pageLede: Photography is my lifelong practice of observation. These frames come from early mornings at the wetlands: flamingos, herons and ibises in the few minutes when low light and behaviour line up. Select a photograph to read the story behind it.

aboutBand.title: Hi, I’m Lalit. I design where technology, business and people meet.
paragraphs: Over a quarter century in product experience design, I’ve focused on **enterprise UX transformation**: modernizing complex, mission-critical platforms without disrupting the business.
Today I lead user experience for a multi-product mainframe portfolio, championing **human-centered AI** and building teams that make design a strategic driver of growth.

about.intro: Over a quarter century in product experience design, I’ve worked where technical architecture, business strategy and human behaviour meet.
paragraphs: My focus is **enterprise UX transformation**: modernizing complex, mission-critical platforms into elegant, defensible software systems without disrupting the business.

As generative systems reshape computing, I champion **human-centered AI and innovation**, building transparent interaction models where human agency and autonomous, agentic workflows work in calibrated harmony.
As a design leader, I build and mentor multidisciplinary UX teams, and move design from a reactive delivery function to a strategic catalyst for customer retention and enterprise growth.
about.currentRole: Senior Manager, User Experience, leading UX for a multi-product enterprise mainframe portfolio.
